在高德开放平台创建 Web 端（JS API）Key 和安全密钥；地点搜索使用单: Create a Web JS API Key and security code in AMap. Place search uses a separate Web Service Key.
密钥保存在当前账号的本机配置中。搜索时只发送地点关键词和城市。: Keys are saved locally for this account. Searches send only place keywords and the city.
点击地图上的具体建筑，再保存地点: Select the building on the map, then save
地图配置已更新，请刷新页面: Map settings changed. Reload the page
地图加载失败，请检查网络与高德配置: Map failed to load. Check your network and AMap settings
底图加载超时，请检查网络与高德配置: Map tiles timed out. Check your network and AMap settings
安排或地点已变更，请刷新后重试: The plan or location changed. Refresh and try again
请先配置高德 Web 服务 Key: Configure an AMap Web Service Key first
无法连接高德地图，请检查网络后重试: Cannot connect to AMap. Check your network and retry
地点搜索失败，请检查 Key、服务权限或配额: Place search failed. Check the key, permissions, or quota
在地图中选择建筑: Choose a building on the map
启用后，此清单的今日安排才显示在地图中: Show today’s scheduled items from this list on the map when enabled
拖动顶栏移动地图窗口: Drag the header to move the map window
在清单设置中启用地图模式，即可显示该清单的今日安排: Enable map mode in a list’s settings to show its scheduled items for today
此安排未列入今日地图，仅编辑它的地点: This item is not included in today’s map; only its location is being edited
未获定位权限，请在系统或浏览器设置中允许位置访问: Location permission denied. Allow location access in system or browser settings.
设备定位超时，可稍后重试: Device location timed out. Try again later.
设备暂未提供位置，请检查系统定位服务: No device location is available. Check system location services.
定位坐标转换失败，请稍后重试: Location coordinate conversion failed. Try again later.
未识别到线下地点，可在安排中补充地址: No physical location found. Add an address to the item.
存在同名地点，请在安排中补充城市或完整地址: Multiple places share this name. Add a city or full address to the item.
未找到匹配建筑，请在安排中补充完整地址: No matching building found. Add a full address to the item.
自动定位需要配置高德 Web 服务 Key: Automatic lookup requires an AMap Web Service Key.
此安排未列入今日地图，可查看它的定位结果: This item is not on today’s map. Its location result is shown here.
地点会自动识别并标记，点击安排可查看地址: Locations are identified and marked automatically. Select an item to view its address.
连接高德地图后，自动识别任务和日程中的地点并标记建筑: Connect AMap to automatically identify locations in tasks and events and mark their buildings.
密钥保存在当前账号的本机配置中。自动识别时只发送提取的地点关键词和城市。: Keys are stored locally for this account. Automatic lookup sends only extracted place keywords and city.
